# qr-scanner

Vendored from [`nimiq/qr-scanner` v1.4.2](https://github.com/nimiq/qr-scanner/tree/v1.4.2).
The legacy browser bundle includes its worker fallback in one file, which keeps
krmax's no-build web console self-contained while still using native barcode
detection when the browser provides it. See `qr-scanner.LICENSE` for the MIT
license.
